tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅// rnal 'byor bzhi'i nges pa rab tu dbye ba phyag rgya chen po'i bshad pa thams cad kyi bla ma bzhugs so//

༄༅// bka' brgyud rin po che la phyag 'tshal lo// e yi mkha' dbyings dbus su waṃ// nges gnas gsang ba mchog gang na// rtag tu dgyes par rol mdzad pa'i/"$ /dpal ldan bla ma'i zhabs la 'dud// gzhi dang nyams len nyams myong dang*// drod rtags 'byed dang 'bras bu ni// mngon gyur rnal 'byor bzhi po 'dir// lam ni nges pa'i mdor bsdus so// gzhi ni gtan la dbab de bzhin// lam du nyams len de nyid las// byung ba'i nyams myong de yi lam// ji ltar bgrod dang mngon gyur 'brel// ma bslad phyir dang mi gnas phyir// mi 'gal phyir dang mi dmigs phyir// gzhi ni rtse gcig spros bral dang*// ro gcig sgom med bzhir bshad do// kun nas nyon mongs nyid dang gzhan// rnam par byang ba zhes bya'i chos// bsal dang bzhag par bya ba ni// cung zad med phyir ma bslad pa// yod dang med sogs ji snyed pa'i// phung po gnyis ni yod min la// dbu mar yang ni mi dmigs pas// mi gnas pa zhes bya bar brjod// ji snyed pa yi chos thams cad// de las gzhan min de nyid kyang*// de snyed pa yi rnam pa la// 'jug phyir de ni mi 'gal ba// gang zhig nye bar brjod pa la// kun mkhyen tshig gis dbul gyur cing*// blo yi yul min dpe gzhan gyis// bsnyad bya min pas mi dmigs pa'o// mi rtog pa dang skye med dang*// gnyis su med dang bsam mi khyab// gang gis ngang la 'jog phyir lam// nyams su len tshul de yang bzhi// ji srid dngos por 'dzin yod pa// de srid srid pa'i brtson rar 'ching*// de bas dngos 'dzin yongs btang ste// dngos med nyid du mi rtog go /gang las skyes shing gang du gnas// gang du 'gag pa ma rnyed nas// rtsa ba bral ba'i de nyid dang*// mnyam par 'jog pa skye med do// ji srid rnam par 'phros de srid// sems kyi rang bzhin nyid yin phyir// dngos po dang ni stong pa nyid// gnyis su med par mnyam par gzhog

/sgom pa cung zad yod min pas// bsgom par bya ba nyid kyang med// sgom dang bsgom bya las 'das pa// de ni bsam mi khyab kyis rig /ji ltar rtse gcig spros bral dang*// ro gcig de bzhin sgom med kyi// rnal 'byor bzhi po nyams myong gi /spu ris phye ba nyid du 'dod// gnas thog 'gyu ba'i rang ngo shes// 'gyu thog gnas pa'i rang sa zin// gnas 'gyu'i bar lag 'gyel ba na// rtse gcig rang ngo 'phrod pa yin// gang zhig skye 'gag rtag chad dang*// 'gro 'ong gcig dang du ma yi// spros pa nyer zhi spros med las// grol bar rtogs pa spros bral lo// dngos kun gtso bo rang sems kyi// ngo bo nyid de legs rtogs pas// thams cad de yin de las gzhan// nam yang rnyed min ro gcig lo// ji ltar me dang bud shing bzhin// cig car spang gnyen zad gyur pa'i// dbyings su chos kun rdzogs pa gang*// bsgom du med pa'i rnal 'byor ro// gang zag dbang po'i bye brag ni// cig car thod brgal rim skyes pa// rnam pa gsum du nges gnas pas// rtogs tshul rnam pa gsum bshad do// de dag brtan pa ma thob dang*// thob dang shin tu thob rim bzhin// chung ngu 'bring dang chen po ste// dbye ba rnam pa bcu gnyis bshad// ji ltar bshad pa'i rnal 'byor bzhi// yon tan nyid kyi rjes 'gro bas// rnam bzhi re rer dbye ba yang*// bzhi bzhi bcu drug dag tu gnas// ngo mthong rnam rtog sgom du shar// rtsal rdzogs yon tan skyes pa dang*// kun rdzob byan tshud gzugs kyi sku'i// sa bon thebs dang ma thebs dbye// rtse gcig sbyor lam spros bral gang*// mthong lam ro gcig sgom lam ste// mi slob lam ni sgom med du// don dam gzigs pa rnams kyis gsungs// ji ltar nges 'byed yan lag ni// bcu gnyis de bzhin rtse gcig go /thun mong min pa'i nges 'byed bzhis// rnal 'byor bzhi ka bsdus pa yin// ma grub pa dang grub pa dang*// grub pa'ang chung 'bring chen po yis// sa mtshams rnam pa bzhir phye ba// rdzogs sangs rgyas kyis rgya cher bshad// rtag tu chos kyi sku nyid las// mi g.yo rtse gcig de nyid kyang*// sgrib pa kun las rnam grol ba// spros bral de las gzhan gyi don// mdzad par snang ba ro gcig ste// de yang thog ma mtha' med pas// sgom med nyid du bshad pa gang*// 'bras bu mngon du gyur pa yi// rnal 'byor rnam pa bzhir brjod do// de ltar shin tu zab mo'i don// bla ma dam pa'i drin thob pas// cha tsam bdag gis 'dir brjod la// nyes pa mchis na bzod par mdzod// 'di ni grub pa'i khyu mchog rnams kyi byin gyis brlabs pa'i gnas chen// mog pa lha rtse'i dgon par padma dkar pos sbyar ba dge legs su gyur cig
